# Portfolio Intelligence

3 of the [62 commands](/commands/). Type each as shown in Claude Code or Cowork; Codex users name the skill.

## `/fundadmin:fund portfolio-dashboard <files>` {#portfolio-dashboard}

Multi-fund portfolio aggregation & analytics

Rolls several funds into one LP view: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, strategy and GP mix, J-curve stage, unfunded. Use for `/fundadmin:fund portfolio-dashboard` or book-level status.

| Host | Invocation |

| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-portfolio-dashboard <files>` |
| Codex | `$fund-portfolio-dashboard <files>` |

**Writes** `PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-portfolio-dashboard/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund reconcile <file1> <file2>` {#reconcile}

Cross-document reconciliation & discrepancy detection

Reconciles two fund documents line by line: call vs statement, distribution vs K-1, or two statements. Use for `/fundadmin:fund reconcile` or balances that don't tie.
